title: Genotype frequencies in Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium
caption: With allele frequencies p and q (p + q = 1) the genotype frequencies are p², 2pq and q². Heterozygotes are most common at q = 0.5, but when a recessive allele is rare almost all copies are in carriers: at q = 0.02 (cystic fibrosis, about 1 in 2,500) the carrier frequency 2pq is about 0.039, roughly 1 in 25.
alt: Three curves against the frequency q of the recessive allele: AA falling from 1 to 0, Aa rising to 0.5 at q = 0.5 and falling, and aa rising from 0 to 1, with q = 0.02 marked.
description: p² (AA) falls from 1 to 0 as q rises.
At every q the three frequencies add up to 1.
axisLabels: frequency of the recessive allele, q
